source_text: Aliud peccatum in sancta Domini, aliud in proximum. Utrumque altare tangit. Dilige Deum et proximum.
pass_a_gloss: Other sin against holy-things of-Lord, other against neighbor. Both altar touches. Love God and neighbor.
pass_b_english: One guilt touches the Lord’s holy things; another the neighbor. Both touch the altar. [[Love God and neighbor >> Bible:Matthew 22:37-39]].
